payload.title: Anniversary Trip Packages for Couples Worth Booking
payload.seo_title: Anniversary Trip Packages for Couples Worth Booking
payload.title_note: User's title kept (51 characters, keyword first, not a question, no colon or dash). H1 and SEO title identical per user rule.
payload.keyword_note: AU volumes (Google Ads, Nov 2026): packages for couples 70, romantic getaway packages 50, anniversary trip packages 10, anniversary holiday packages 10. Do NOT target 'anniversary trip ideas' (owned by /celebration-ideas/anniversary-trip-ideas).

audience.notes: Australian couples in their 30s, already married, AUD 150K+ household celebration budget, planning an anniversary trip (often the 5th or 10th, sometimes a parent's 25th or 50th as a gift). Couple persona fears adapted to this trip: (1) paying luxury prices for a package that turns out generic, the same bundle anyone can click; (2) booking from Australia with no one accountable when flights, transfers or the room go wrong.

payload.search_intent: Commercial: compare package types and decide whether to book a bundle or have an advisor tailor one. SERP is transactional catalogues in Sydney and Melbourne, informational listicles in Brisbane and Perth.
payload.angle: The buyer's guide the ranking catalogues skip: what a luxury anniversary trip package should include, how a catalogue bundle differs from a tailored package, and the invisible work a Wedded Advisor handles so the anniversary itself is the point of the trip.
serp_gaps_to_win: No ranking page explains what an anniversary package includes and leaves out; answer as inclusion categories framed as questions.
No page compares a package with planning it yourself or with an advisor-tailored trip.
All ranking packages are domestic or price-led; none serves an international milestone trip at the 150K+ level.
No page ties the trip to the milestone or to a private moment (dinner, vow renewal) on the trip.
No booking checklist; AI Overview at position 1 in all four cities rewards a clear definition and a scannable list.

outline.h2: What does an anniversary trip package actually include?
outline.answers: Definition in the first 2 sentences (AI Overview target), then inclusion categories phrased as questions: Are flights and transfers in? Which room category, and is the view written into the booking? Which meals and is the anniversary dinner private? What experiences are held, not just suggested? Is travel insurance and flexibility covered?
must_include: one quotable 40 to 50 word definition
categories only, no competitor packages or prices
what packages commonly leave out (transfers between islands, the private dinner, upgrades, timing around the actual date)

outline.h2: Should you book a package or plan the trip yourself?
outline.answers: Honest comparison of three routes: catalogue bundle, self-planned, advisor-tailored package. When each makes sense.
must_include: fair case for DIY (link /travel-guides/weekly-itinerary-template)
fear 1: generic result at a luxury price
no prices

outline.h2: How does a travel advisor shape an anniversary trip?
outline.answers: Invisible work: flight timing around the date, transfers, room category and view confirmed in writing, the private dinner or vow moment, weather back-up, one contact when something changes. Link /travel and /destination-packages here (user rule: trip section links /packages and /travel; /packages is NOT LIVE so /destination-packages).
must_include: fear 2: one accountable contact from Australia
travel privileges only as worded on /travel: 'eligible stays may include daily breakfast, a hotel credit and upgrade priority. Benefits vary by hotel and program.'
any industry claim about advisors linked to an official source at the claim (e.g. ATIA or ACCC); no reuse of DRAFT travel-advisor article facts unless re-sourced

outline.answers: Short, by milestone (first, 10th, 25th, 50th) only where our live pages support it; point to the ideas article for the full list rather than repeating it.

link 25th and 50th pages

no milestone fact without a source

outline.h2: Where should you go for an anniversary trip package?
outline.answers: 4 to 5 destinations we have live pages for, one line each on why they suit a couple's milestone and what the package should cover there.
must_include: destinations from /destination-packages wording only (Bali, Santorini, the Maldives, Fiji, Phuket, Koh Samui, South Australia) plus Amalfi Coast and Greece pages
link our destination pages, not competitors
do not repeat 'complimentary' from the Bali hub copy

outline.h2: What should you check before you book?
outline.answers: Scannable checklist: dates around the anniversary, what is in writing (room, view, dinner), transfer plan, cancellation and change terms, insurance, who to call on the ground, passport validity.
must_include: official sources at the claim for passport or travel advice (Smartraveller, passports.gov.au)
checklist formatted as a list

payload.differentiation: The ideas article answers 'where and what' by milestone (informational); this piece answers 'what should the package include and how do we book it well' (commercial). Keep the milestone and destination sections short, link to the ideas and places articles with descriptive anchors, and spend the words on inclusions, the package vs DIY vs advisor decision, the advisor's invisible work and the booking checklist. Not a total overlap; a new page is justified.
image_slots: hero: married couple on a private terrace at golden hour, overseas resort, no faces needed
inclusions: table set for two, private dinner on a beach or clifftop
advisor: villa or overwater room arrival with luggage handled
milestone: older couple (25th or 50th) on a quiet coastal walk
destination: Amalfi Coast or Santorini view
checklist: passports, itinerary and two glasses on a hotel desk
